snippet.title: Smiley Arena Trailer
snippet.description:
🛡️ Smiley Arena – Tower Defense With Bite!

Pick from 6 unique classes, each with their own abilities, build up your defense, and hold the line against endless waves of enemies – including powerful bosses every few waves. Every class plays completely differently:

🔥 Fire – AoE inferno strike that burns nearby enemies ❄️ Ice – freezes entire groups of enemies solid 👻 Shadow – invisible ambush with a guaranteed critical hit ⚕️ Medic – instantly heals you and repairs your turrets 💣 Bomb – massive bombs with a huge blast radius ⚡ Speed – lightning-fast dash straight through enemy lines

Build and upgrade your turrets, unlock powerful perks, and face bosses that hit back harder every single time. How far can you get?

👉 Wishlist it now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5053510/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer&utm_medium=video
